language.title: Language
language.label: Language
language.hint: The language Box Office shows you, on every device you sign in on. Automatic follows each browser's language.
language.machine: This translation was made by machine, so some wording may be off.

broken.title: This page hit a problem
broken.body: The rest of Box Office is still working. Reloading usually fixes it. If it keeps happening, include the text below in a bug report.

push.installApple: To install it on an iPhone or iPad, open this page in Safari, tap the Share button, then tap Add to Home Screen.
push.installMenu: To install it, open the browser's menu and choose Install or Add to Home screen.
push.testSent: Sent. It should show up in a moment.

why.insecure: Notifications only work when this page is opened over https. This one was opened over plain http.
why.apple: On an iPhone or iPad, notifications work once this is installed: open this page in Safari, tap the Share button, then Add to Home Screen. Then turn them on here, in the installed app.
why.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser. Allow them in the browser's settings for this site, then turn this on again.

sso.refused: That sign-in was cancelled or turned down.
sso.notallowed: That account isn't let in here. Ask whoever runs this server.
sso.failed: That sign-in didn't work. Whoever runs this server can see why in its log.
